exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean sign f, let R_c be the spectral Bregman remainder of k(t)=-t^2 log2(t^2)+3t^2/ln2 for the edit to constant c=+1 or -1, with continuous zero terms. Writing mu=E f, R_c=H+4/ln2+c(2mu log2(mu^2)-4mu/ln2). Thus R_++R_-=2H+8/ln2 and R_min=H+a(abs(mu)), where a(u)=4(1-u+u ln u)/ln2 and 0<=a(abs(mu))<=4I^2/ln2. Every nonconstant Boolean seed embeds into actual Boolean functions F_t with I(F_t)->0, mean->1 and R_min(F_t)/I(F_t)->H(seed)/I(seed). If C_star=sup_all H/I in the extended reals and M(eps)=sup_{0<I<=eps}R_min/I, then C_star<=M(eps)<=C_star+4eps/ln2 and lim_{eps down to0}M(eps)=C_star. A uniform small-influence bound R_min<=KI implies full FEI at the SAME K. No exact fixed-eps converse or critical-witness admission is asserted.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs on finite uniform cubes, normalized real Walsh coefficients, entropy bits
Zero terms continuous; convexity only needed on [-1,1]
Ratios use I>0; constants have R_min=H=0
Fixed seed nonconstant; disjoint tensor, fresh balancing literal, ceil(sqrt(t)) fair point controls
No finite maximality, minimal dimension or actual child certification assumed or concluded
proof_dependencies: Parseval, elementary log inequality and explicit finite activation spectrum; no unproved FEI estimate
